```yaml
name: Coverage Badge

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.9", "3.10", "3.11", "3.12"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          cache: 'pip'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest pytest-cov coverage
          if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
          if [ -f setup.py ]; then pip install .; fi
          if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install .; fi

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: |
          pytest --cov=. --cov-report=xml:coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml --cov-report=term-missing

      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          files: coverage-${{ matrix.python-version }}.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false
          verbose: true

  generate-badge:
    needs: coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install requests

      - name: Generate Coverage Badge
        run: |
          python -c "
          import requests
          import json
          import os
          
          # Fetch coverage data from Codecov API
          # Note: This assumes the repository is public or you have a token configured.
          # For private repos, you would need to pass a CODECOV_TOKEN.
          owner = '${{ github.repository_owner }}'
          repo = '${{ github.event.repository.name }}'
          
          # Using the public API endpoint for the latest commit coverage
          url = f'https://codecov.io/api/v2/{owner}/{repo}/coverage'
          
          try:
              response = requests.get(url)
              if response.status_code == 200:
                  data = response.json()
                  # Extract coverage percentage
                  # The structure might vary, typically it's under 'coverage' or 'commit_coverage'
                  # We'll try to find a percentage value
                  coverage_pct = 0
                  if 'coverage' in data:
                      coverage_pct = data['coverage']
                  elif 'commit_coverage' in data:
                      coverage_pct = data['commit_coverage'].get('pct_change', 0)
                  else:
                      # Fallback or specific field lookup depending on API version
                      # Often it's just a number in the root or under a specific key
                      for key in data:
                          if isinstance(data[key], (int, float)):
                              coverage_pct = data[key]
                              break
                  
                  # Format percentage
                  coverage_str = f'{coverage_pct:.1f}%'
                  
                  # Create SVG badge
                  svg = '''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"120\" height=\"20\">
                    <linearGradient id=\"b\" x2=\"0\" y2=\"100%\">
                      <stop offset=\"0\" stop-color=\"#bbb\" stop-opacity=\".1\"/>
                      <stop offset=\"1\" stop-opacity=\".1\"/>
                    </linearGradient>
                    <clipPath id=\"a\">
                      <rect width=\"120\" height=\"20\" rx=\"3\" fill=\"#fff\"/>
                    </clipPath>
                    <g clip-path=\"url(#a)\">
                      <path fill=\"#555\" d=\"M0 0h63v20H0z\"/>
                      <path fill=\"#4c1\" d=\"M63 0h57v20H63z\"/>
                      <path fill=\"url(#b)\" d=\"M0 0h120v20H0z\"/>
                    </g>
                    <g fill=\"#fff\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-family=\"DejaVu Sans,Verdana,Geneva,sans-serif\" font-size=\"11\">
                      <text x=\"31.5\" y=\"15\" fill=\"#010101\" fill-opacity=\".3\">coverage</text>
                      <text x=\"31.5\" y=\"14\">coverage</text>
                      <text x=\"91.5\" y=\"15\" fill=\"#010101\" fill-opacity=\".3\">{coverage_str}</text>
                      <text x=\"91.5\" y=\"14\">{coverage_str}</text>
                    </g>
                  </svg>'''
                  
                  with open('coverage-badge.svg', 'w') as f:
                      f.write(svg)
                  print(f'Generated badge with coverage: {coverage_str}')
              else:
                  print(f'Failed to fetch coverage data: {response.status_code}')
                  # Create a default badge if API fails
                  svg = '''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"120\" height=\"20\">
                    <linearGradient id=\"b\" x2=\"0\" y2=\"100%\">
                      <stop offset=\"0\" stop-color=\"#bbb\" stop-opacity=\".1\"/>
                      <stop offset=\"1\" stop-opacity=\".1\"/>
                    </linearGradient>
                    <clipPath id=\"a\">
                      <rect width=\"120\" height=\"20\" rx=\"3\" fill=\"#fff\"/>
                    </clipPath>
                    <g clip-path=\"url(#a)\">
                      <path fill=\"#555\" d=\"M0 0h63v20H0z\"/>
                      <path fill=\"#e05d44\" d=\"M63 0h57v20H63z\"/>
                      <path fill=\"url(#b)\" d=\"M0 0h120v20H0z\"/>
                    </g>
                    <g fill=\"#fff\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-family=\"DejaVu Sans,Verdana,Geneva,sans-serif\" font-size=\"11\">
                      <text x=\"31.5\" y=\"15\" fill=\"#010101\" fill-opacity=\".3\">coverage</text>
                      <text x=\"31.5\" y=\"14\">coverage</text>
                      <text x=\"91.5\" y=\"15\" fill=\"#010101\" fill-opacity=\".3\">unknown</text>
                      <text x=\"91.5\" y=\"14\">unknown</text>
                    </g>
                  </svg>'''
                  with open('coverage-badge.svg', 'w') as f:
                      f.write(svg)
          except Exception as e:
              print(f'Error generating badge: {e}')
              # Create a default badge if error occurs
              svg = '''<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"120\" height=\"20\">
                <linearGradient id=\"b\" x2=\"0\" y2=\"100%\">
                  <stop offset=\"0\" stop-color=\"#bbb\" stop-opacity=\".1\"/>
                  <stop offset=\"1\" stop-opacity=\".1\"/>
                </linearGradient>
                <clipPath id=\"a\">
                  <rect width=\"120\" height=\"20\" rx=\"3\" fill=\"#fff\"/>
                </clipPath>
                <g clip-path=\"url(#a)\">
                  <path fill=\"#555\" d=\"M0 0h63v20H0z\"/>
                  <path fill=\"#e05d44\" d=\"M63 0h57v20H63z\"/>
                  <path fill=\"url(#b)\" d=\"M0 0h120v20H0z\"/>
                </g>
                <g fill=\"#fff\" text-anchor=\"middle\" font-family=\"DejaVu Sans,Verdana,Geneva,sans-serif\" font-size=\"11\">
                  <text x=\"31.5\" y=\"15\" fill=\"#010101\" fill-opacity=\".3\">coverage</text>
                  <text x=\"31.5\" y=\"14\">coverage</text>
                  <text x=\"91.5\" y=\"15\" fill=\"#010101\" fill-opacity=\".3\">error</text>
                  <text x=\"91.5\" y=\"14\">error</text>
                </g>
              </svg>'''
              with open('coverage-badge.svg', 'w') as f:
                  f.write(svg)
"

      - name: Commit and push badge
        uses: stefanzweifel/git-auto-commit-action@04702edda442b2e678b25b537cec683a1493fcb9
        with:
          commit_message: "Update coverage badge"
          file_pattern: "coverage-badge.svg"
          commit_user_name: "github-actions[bot]"
          commit_user_email: "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
```
